description: This Java source file defines a class 'ShoppingListServices' that provides various service methods related to shopping lists in an order management system, including creating recurrences, reordering, splitting shipment methods, creating shopping lists from orders, updating quantities, and cleaning up auto-saved shopping lists.

classes.name: ShoppingListServices
classes.description: This class provides static service methods for managing shopping lists within the order system, including creation, updating, recurring schedules, reordering, and cleanup of obsolete lists.

methods.name: setShoppingListRecurrence
methods.description: Sets the recurrence schedule for a shopping list based on provided start/end dates, frequency, and interval, returning a recurrence info ID.

methods.name: createListReorders
methods.description: Creates reorder entries for active automatic shopping lists that are due for reordering, processes orders, payments, and notifications within a transaction.

methods.name: splitShipmentMethodString
methods.description: Splits a combined shipment method string into shipment method type ID and carrier party ID.

methods.name: makeListFromOrder
methods.description: Creates or updates a shopping list based on an existing order, migrating order items and optionally creating recurring schedules.

methods.name: makeShoppingListCart
methods.description: Builds a shopping cart object based on a shopping list, optionally adding items and properties from the list.

methods.name: makeShoppingListCart
methods.description: Overloaded method to build a shopping cart from a shopping list ID.

methods.name: updateShoppingListQuantitiesFromOrder
methods.description: Updates the quantities purchased in shopping list items based on the quantities from a specific order ID.

methods.name: autoDeleteAutoSaveShoppingList
methods.description: Deletes obsolete auto-saved shopping lists older than a specified maximum age, processing in paged chunks within transactional boundaries.
